en.g: Learn the words you need to talk about staying safe online.
p: Accounts: a strong password, two-step login, log in, log out, update your apps, back up your files.
Dangers: a scam, a fake message, a suspicious link, a hacker. Never share your password with anyone.
Privacy: check your privacy settings, think before you post, only accept people you know.

en.g: Contrast ideas with although, even though, however, despite and in spite of.
p: Although / even though + clause: Although it was raining, we went out. Even though is stronger.
However starts a new sentence, with a comma: The hotel was old. However, it was very clean.
Despite / in spite of + noun or -ing: Despite the rain, we went out. In spite of feeling tired, she kept going.

en.g: Explain causes and effects with because of, due to, so, therefore and as a result.

en.t: Purpose: to, in order to, so that
en.g: Explain why people do things with to, in order to and so that.
p: To + verb is the most common: I study English to travel. She went to the shop to buy bread.
In order to is more formal; in order not to for negatives: We left early in order not to miss the train.
So that + subject + can/could/will: I save money so that I can travel. I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget.

en.t: Time clauses: as soon as, until
en.g: Order events clearly with as soon as, until, by the time and while.
p: As soon as = immediately after: Call me as soon as you arrive. I'll start as soon as I finish lunch.
Until = up to that moment: Wait here until I come back. By the time = before or when: By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Future meaning but present tense after time words: I'll text you when I get home, not when I will get home.
en.q: What is the first thing you do as soon as you wake up, and what do you do while you have breakfast?
en.c: Write five sentences about tomorrow with as soon as, until, before, while and by the time. Remember: present after the time word!

de.t: Time clauses: as soon as, until
de.g: Mit as soon as, until, by the time und while ordnest du Ereignisse klar.
p: As soon as = sofort nachdem: Call me as soon as you arrive. I'll start as soon as I finish lunch.
Until = bis zu dem Moment: Wait here until I come back. By the time = bis: By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Zukunftsbedeutung, aber Präsens nach Zeitwörtern: I'll text you when I get home, nicht when I will get home.
de.q: Was machst du als Erstes, sobald du aufwachst, und was tust du, während du frühstückst?
de.c: Schreib fünf Sätze über morgen mit as soon as, until, before, while und by the time. Denk dran: Präsens nach dem Zeitwort!

p: As soon as = en cuanto: Call me as soon as you arrive. I'll start as soon as I finish lunch.
Until = hasta que: Wait here until I come back. By the time = para cuando: By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Sentido futuro pero presente tras estas palabras: I'll text you when I get home, no when I will get home.

Until = jusqu'à ce que : Wait here until I come back. By the time = le temps que : By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Sens futur mais présent après ces mots : I'll text you when I get home, et non when I will get home.

it.t: Time clauses: as soon as, until
it.g: Ordina gli eventi con chiarezza usando as soon as, until, by the time e while.
p: As soon as = appena: Call me as soon as you arrive. I'll start as soon as I finish lunch.
Until = finché: Wait here until I come back. By the time = quando ormai: By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Senso futuro ma presente dopo queste parole: I'll text you when I get home, non when I will get home.
it.q: Qual è la prima cosa che fai appena ti svegli, e cosa fai mentre fai colazione?
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi su domani con as soon as, until, before, while e by the time. Ricorda: presente dopo la parola di tempo!

pt.t: Time clauses: as soon as, until
pt.g: Ordena os acontecimentos com clareza usando as soon as, until, by the time e while.
p: As soon as = assim que: Call me as soon as you arrive. I'll start as soon as I finish lunch.
Until = até: Wait here until I come back. By the time = quando: By the time we arrived, the show had started.
Sentido futuro mas presente depois destas palavras: I'll text you when I get home, e não when I will get home.
pt.q: Qual é a primeira coisa que fazes assim que acordas, e o que fazes enquanto tomas o pequeno-almoço?
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases sobre amanhã com as soon as, until, before, while e by the time. Lembra-te: presente depois da palavra de tempo!

en.t: Giving examples: such as, for instance
en.g: Support your ideas with clear examples.
p: Such as / like + noun, inside the sentence: I love outdoor sports, such as hiking and kayaking.
For example / for instance, often with commas, can start a sentence: Some foods are very healthy. For example, beans.
Like is informal; such as is more neutral. Don't overuse: one or two examples are usually enough.
en.q: What are some things you can do in your city for free? Give examples with such as or for instance.
en.c: Write three opinions and support each one with an example: use such as, for example and for instance once each.

de.t: Giving examples: such as, for instance
de.g: Du stützt deine Ideen mit klaren Beispielen.
p: Such as / like + Nomen, mitten im Satz: I love outdoor sports, such as hiking and kayaking.
For example / for instance, oft mit Kommas, auch am Satzanfang: Some foods are very healthy. For example, beans.
Like ist umgangssprachlich, such as neutraler. Ein oder zwei Beispiele reichen meistens.
de.q: Was kann man in deiner Stadt kostenlos machen? Nenne Beispiele mit such as oder for instance.
de.c: Schreib drei Meinungen und stütze jede mit einem Beispiel: benutze je einmal such as, for example und for instance.

es.t: Giving examples: such as, for instance
es.g: Apoya tus ideas con ejemplos claros.
p: Such as / like + sustantivo, dentro de la frase: I love outdoor sports, such as hiking and kayaking.
For example / for instance, a menudo con comas, pueden abrir la frase: Some foods are very healthy. For example, beans.
Like es informal; such as, más neutro. No abuses: uno o dos ejemplos suelen bastar.
es.q: ¿Qué cosas se pueden hacer gratis en tu ciudad? Da ejemplos con such as o for instance.
es.c: Escribe tres opiniones y apoya cada una con un ejemplo: usa una vez such as, for example y for instance.

fr.t: Giving examples: such as, for instance
fr.g: Appuie tes idées avec des exemples clairs.
p: Such as / like + nom, dans la phrase : I love outdoor sports, such as hiking and kayaking.
For example / for instance, souvent entre virgules, peuvent ouvrir la phrase : Some foods are very healthy. For example, beans.
Like est familier ; such as est plus neutre. Un ou deux exemples suffisent en général.
fr.q: Que peut-on faire gratuitement dans ta ville ? Donne des exemples avec such as ou for instance.
fr.c: Écris trois opinions et appuie chacune d'un exemple : utilise une fois such as, for example et for instance.

it.t: Giving examples: such as, for instance

p: Such as / like + nome, dentro la frase: I love outdoor sports, such as hiking and kayaking.
For example / for instance, spesso tra virgole, possono aprire la frase: Some foods are very healthy. For example, beans.
Like è informale; such as è più neutro. Non esagerare: uno o due esempi di solito bastano.
it.q: Cosa si può fare gratis nella tua città? Fai esempi con such as o for instance.
it.c: Scrivi tre opinioni e sostienile con un esempio ciascuna: usa una volta such as, for example e for instance.

pt.q: O que se pode fazer de graça na tua cidade? Dá exemplos com such as ou for instance.
pt.c: Escreve três opiniões e apoia cada uma com um exemplo: usa uma vez such as, for example e for instance.

en.g: Write a clear paragraph with a topic sentence, details and a closing line.
p: Topic sentence: the main idea in one line. Learning a language has many benefits.
Supporting details: two or three reasons or examples with linkers. First, ... Also, ... For example, ...
Closing line: sum up or give your view. All in all, it's worth the effort. Stay on one main idea.
en.q: If you wrote a paragraph about your hometown, what would your topic sentence be?
en.c: Write one paragraph (5 to 7 sentences) on a topic you like: a topic sentence, three supporting details and a closing line.

de.g: Du schreibst einen klaren Absatz mit Kernsatz, Details und Schlusssatz.
p: Kernsatz: die Hauptidee in einer Zeile. Learning a language has many benefits.
Details: zwei oder drei Gründe oder Beispiele mit Verbindungswörtern. First, ... Also, ... For example, ...
Schlusssatz: zusammenfassen oder Meinung sagen. All in all, it's worth the effort. Bleib bei einer Hauptidee.
de.q: Wenn du einen Absatz über deine Heimatstadt schreiben würdest, wie würde dein Kernsatz lauten?
de.c: Schreib einen Absatz (5 bis 7 Sätze) zu einem Thema, das du magst: Kernsatz, drei Details und ein Schlusssatz.

es.g: Escribe un párrafo claro con una frase principal, detalles y una frase final.
p: Frase principal: la idea central en una línea. Learning a language has many benefits.
Detalles: dos o tres razones o ejemplos con conectores. First, ... Also, ... For example, ...
Frase final: resume o da tu opinión. All in all, it's worth the effort. Céntrate en una sola idea.
es.q: Si escribieras un párrafo sobre tu ciudad natal, ¿cuál sería tu frase principal?
es.c: Escribe un párrafo (de 5 a 7 frases) sobre un tema que te guste: frase principal, tres detalles y una frase final.

Conclusion : résume ou donne ton avis. All in all, it's worth the effort. Reste sur une seule idée.
fr.q: Si tu écrivais un paragraphe sur ta ville natale, quelle serait ta phrase clé ?
fr.c: Écris un paragraphe (5 à 7 phrases) sur un sujet que tu aimes : une phrase clé, trois détails et une conclusion.

it.q: Se scrivessi un paragrafo sulla tua città natale, quale sarebbe la frase principale?
it.c: Scrivi un paragrafo (da 5 a 7 frasi) su un tema che ti piace: frase principale, tre dettagli e una chiusura.

en.g: Plan and write a simple opinion essay in clear steps.
p: Introduction: present the topic and your view. Many people think... In my opinion...
Body: two arguments with reasons and examples, then one counter-argument. Some people argue that... However...
Conclusion: repeat your view in new words. To sum up, ... For these reasons, I believe...
en.q: Here's a topic: Is it better to live in the city or the countryside? What is your opinion, and what is one argument against it?
en.c: Plan an essay on a topic you choose: write one sentence for the introduction, two arguments, one counter-argument and the conclusion.

de.g: Du planst und schreibst Schritt für Schritt einen einfachen Meinungsaufsatz.
p: Einleitung: Thema und Meinung vorstellen. Many people think... In my opinion...
Hauptteil: zwei Argumente mit Gründen und Beispielen, dann ein Gegenargument. Some people argue that... However...
Schluss: Meinung mit neuen Worten wiederholen. To sum up, ... For these reasons, I believe...
de.q: Ein Thema: Lebt man besser in der Stadt oder auf dem Land? Was meinst du, und was spricht dagegen?
de.c: Plane einen Aufsatz zu einem Thema deiner Wahl: je ein Satz für Einleitung, zwei Argumente, ein Gegenargument und Schluss.

es.g: Planifica y escribe un ensayo de opinión sencillo paso a paso.

Conclusión: repite tu opinión con otras palabras. To sum up, ... For these reasons, I believe...
es.q: Un tema: ¿es mejor vivir en la ciudad o en el campo? ¿Qué opinas, y cuál es un argumento en contra?
es.c: Planifica un ensayo sobre un tema que elijas: una frase para la introducción, dos argumentos, un contraargumento y la conclusión.

fr.c: Planifie un essai sur un sujet de ton choix : une phrase d'introduction, deux arguments, un contre-argument et la conclusion.

it.g: Pianifica e scrivi un semplice saggio d'opinione passo dopo passo.

vocab.ex: In my opinion, everyone should learn to cook.

target.gram: Opinion essay: intro with your view, body with Firstly / Another reason is, a counter-argument (Some people argue...), then To sum up.

en.g: Recap work English, tech vocabulary and linking words with a short debate.
p: Work: Tell me about yourself. I'm writing to... Could I add something? That sounds fair. I'll sort it out.
Tech and life: scroll, share, a strong password, a scam, on the one hand, sustainable, endangered, research shows.
Linking: although, however, despite, because of, as a result, so that, as soon as, such as, to sum up.

vocab.ex: Although remote work is flexible, it can feel lonely.

To sum up, a mix of both works best for me.
